name: vscode-fast-index
description: Lightning-fast text search for VS Code using a background inverted trigram index.

commands.title: Fast Index: Open Results in Editor

fastIndex.includeExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to index (e.g., ts,js,md). Leave empty to index all extensions.

fastIndex.excludePatterns.description: File and folder patterns to ignore during indexing (Glob format). Hidden folders (names starting with '.') are excluded by default.

fastIndex.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size in kilobytes to index. Files larger than this will be skipped.

fastIndex.maxResultsPerFile.description: Maximum matching lines shown per file (0 = no limit). Keeps one huge file from filling the whole result list.

fastIndex.maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to display.

fastIndex.debounceDelay.description: Input delay (in milliseconds) before triggering the search.

fastIndex.resultContextLines.description: Lines shown above and below each match in the results editor (2 = two above, two below).

fastIndex.hoverJumpDelay.description: Milliseconds to rest the pointer on a search result before the results editor jumps to that line. 0 jumps immediately.

fastIndex.persistPinnedSearches.description: Keep pinned searches in the workspace storage so they survive a restart. When off, pins live only for the current session.

fastIndex.followEditor.description: Keep the search box in sync with the editor: use the selection, or the word under the cursor, while the panel is open.

fastIndex.maxRecentSearches.description: How many recent searches the search box remembers (0 disables the history).

fastIndex.autoOpenResults.description: Open the results editor automatically whenever a search finds matches and that editor is not already open. It appears without taking focus, so typing in the panel continues undisturbed.

fastIndex.autoSearchFromResults.description: Let clicking or selecting inside the results editor update the search box (Auto Search). Off by default, so selecting a result line there never disturbs your query.

fastIndex.showContextLine.description: Show the matched line of code (the hit's context line) under each result in the panel. Turn it off for a compact file-and-line list.

fastIndex.panelFontSize.description: Font size in pixels for the Fast Index panel (search results, pinned searches, buttons). Everything in the panel scales with it.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile
